programs.name: Computer Science
programs.description: Comprehensive CS program at Berlin's premier technical university. Software engineering, algorithms, AI, and media informatics. Berlin's growing startup ecosystem provides internship and career opportunities.

programs.name: Architecture
programs.description: Five-year integrated program in Architecture. Studio-based design work, building theory, structural engineering, and urban planning. Berlin offers a vibrant architecture scene with many historic and contemporary buildings.

programs.name: Electrical Engineering
programs.description: Power engineering, electronics, and telecommunications. Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science. Berlin's location offers connections to German energy and manufacturing sectors.

programs.name: Urban and Regional Planning
programs.description: Focus on sustainable urban development, spatial planning, and metropolitan management. English-taught with international student body. Berlin as a case study for urban innovation.
entryRequirements: Urban Planning, Geography, Architecture, or Civil Engineering bachelor

programs.name: Computer Engineering
programs.description: Hardware-software co-design, embedded systems, and computer architecture. Combines electrical engineering and computer science perspectives.

programs.name: Mechanical Engineering
programs.description: Specializations in energy technology, production technology, and automotive engineering. TU Berlin's mechanical engineering faculty is highly regarded in German industry.
